capabilities: Record audio from a right sidebar panel with pause and stop
Transcribe speech in real time via local macOS/Windows speech or OpenAI-compatible STT
Summarize and translate transcripts using vault templates or freeform prompts
Save template summaries, raw transcripts, and audio files into the target note
Write meeting metadata such as participants and consent into frontmatter
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly true). README warns API keys are stored in plaintext in plugin settings and that the Windows speech path is structured but not yet verified on real Windows hardware. Sends audio and transcript text to the selected cloud provider when cloud STT or AI summarization is used; no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's audio recorder can capture sound but offers no transcription, summarization, or archiving, so turning voice meetings into structured notes needs outside tools.
